title: Bunker Blitz
description: A fast, old-school first-person shooter. Rogue security drones have taken over the bunker — clear each wave, grab ammo and med-packs, and see how deep you can last. Scouts are quick, Brutes soak up shots, and every wave brings more of them.
instructions: Click to lock the mouse. WASD to move, mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, Shift to sprint. Arrow keys also turn. On touch: left thumb moves, right thumb turns, tap FIRE.
